mapper.select: SELECT parent.category_id AS parentCategoryId, parent.category_code AS parentCategoryCode, parent.category_name AS parentCategoryName, child.category_id AS categoryId, child.category_code AS categoryCode, child.category_name AS categoryName, CASE WHEN personalization_category.category_key IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS selected, merchant.merchant_id AS merchantId, merchant.merchant_name AS merchantName, FALSE AS merchantSelected, NULL AS priority FROM category parent JOIN category child ON child.parent_category_id = parent.category_id LEFT JOIN merchant ON merchant.category_id = child.category_id LEFT JOIN member_personalization_category personalization_category ON personalization_category.member_id = #{memberId} AND (personalization_category.category_key = child.category_code OR personalization_category.category_key = CASE child.category_code WHEN 'CAFE' THEN 'cafe' WHEN 'CONVENIENCE_STORE' THEN 'convenience' WHEN 'RESTAURANT' THEN 'food' WHEN 'DELIVERY' THEN 'restaurant' WHEN 'LARGE_MART' THEN 'mart' WHEN 'DEPARTMENT_STORE' THEN 'department' WHEN 'BEAUTY' THEN 'beauty' WHEN 'CULTURE_LEISURE' THEN 'culture' WHEN 'PUBLIC_TRANSPORT' THEN 'transport' WHEN 'FUEL' THEN 'gas' ELSE child.category_code END) WHERE parent.parent_category_id IS NULL ORDER BY parent.display_order, child.display_order, merchant.merchant_id

SELECT child.category_id AS categoryId, brand.brand_name AS brandName, brand.priority AS priority FROM member_personalization_brand brand JOIN category child ON (brand.category_key = child.category_code OR brand.category_key = CASE child.category_code WHEN 'CAFE' THEN 'cafe' WHEN 'CONVENIENCE_STORE' THEN 'convenience' WHEN 'RESTAURANT' THEN 'food' WHEN 'DELIVERY' THEN 'restaurant' WHEN 'LARGE_MART' THEN 'mart' WHEN 'DEPARTMENT_STORE' THEN 'department' WHEN 'BEAUTY' THEN 'beauty' WHEN 'CULTURE_LEISURE' THEN 'culture' WHEN 'PUBLIC_TRANSPORT' THEN 'transport' WHEN 'FUEL' THEN 'gas' ELSE child.category_code END) WHERE brand.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY child.category_id, brand.priority
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_personalization_brand (member_id, category_key, priority, brand_name) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{categoryKey}, #{priority}, #{brandName})
